threshold_selection_objective: Optimized on validation set to maximize F1 score while penalizing false alarms

validation_streaming_metrics.uncertainty_note: Statistical Uncertainty Note: The val split contains 400.1 seconds (0.1111 hours) of negative audio. Because audio duration is under one hour, extrapolated hourly rates have wide 95% Poisson confidence intervals. Rates reflect instantaneous sensitivity on mechanical foley and must not be presented as stationary long-term estimates.

held_out_test_streaming_metrics.uncertainty_note: Statistical Uncertainty Note: The test split contains 198.6 seconds (0.0552 hours) of negative audio. Because audio duration is under one hour, extrapolated hourly rates have wide 95% Poisson confidence intervals. Rates reflect instantaneous sensitivity on mechanical foley and must not be presented as stationary long-term estimates.

objective_f1_optimal.description: Maximizes validation F1 score. Yields 100% gunshot recall on test set, but suffers 1,118.1 false alerts/hr on firearm foley.

objective_nuisance_constrained.description: Constrains false alerts to <100/hr on real foley and 0/hr on synthetic noise. Yields 82.3% gunshot recall (3 narrow shots missed).

objective_safety_critical.reason: Achieving <= 1 false alert per day on continuous background is unachievable with current dataset without unacceptable (>50%) gunshot miss rates.

latency_benchmark.latency_explanation: Acoustic audio is captured continuously and sliced into 0.96s windows with a 0.48s hop stride. A sound occurring at an arbitrary time must wait up to 480ms for the hop buffer to fill before framing and inference occur. Model inference time alone (~185ms) is NOT end-to-end latency.

confirm_windows_1.description: Capture hop buffer (480ms) + preprocessing (2.5ms) + YAMNet inference (~185ms) + dispatch (0.2ms)

confirm_windows_2.description: Capture hop buffer (480ms) + confirmation hop (480ms) + preprocessing + YAMNet inference + dispatch

metric_definitions.gunshot_event_start: Timestamp of the start of the first window whose model score exceeds the threshold.
metric_definitions.gunshot_alert_confirmed: When confirm_windows consecutive overlapping windows exceed the threshold.
metric_definitions.refractory_cooldown: 2.0s lockout preventing repeat alerts on echoing or reverberant tails of the same gunshot.
metric_definitions.end_to_end_latency: Sum of hardware hop accumulation period (480ms), framing overhead (2.5ms), neural model inference (~185ms), and confirmation hop delay (0ms or 480ms).

dataset_gaps_disclosure: Downloaded dataset lacks real-world recordings of fireworks, vehicle backfires, and slamming doors. Synthetic noise and simple synthesized knocks do not substitute for varied real-world negative recordings.
operational_safety_disclaimer: CRITICAL DISCLAIMER: This gunshot detection model is designed for research, prototyping, and evaluation purposes only. It MUST NOT be relied upon as a primary safety system, emergency response trigger, or life-critical monitoring apparatus.
